sections.title: Salary structures overview
sections.content:
## Purpose

A salary structure defines the components of a driver's salary and how it is calculated. A structure can only be used for calculation when it is **Approved**.

## Access

**Menu:** Driver salary > Salary structures

![](/uploads/166e1139d33cc45e47c0a07f.png)

## Types of salary structure

The system has two types of structure:

- **Dispatch Salary**: the trip salary structure.
- **Monthly Salary**: the monthly salary structure.

Choose the correct **Structure Type** before configuring the salary components.

![](/uploads/ee85f1e646128fdaecfb6787.png)

sections.title: Creating a salary structure
sections.content:
### Step 1

Click **New**.

![](/uploads/add067b9fc02b4f886628297.png)

### Step 2

Enter the general information and choose the **Structure Type**.

![](/uploads/ab4b760e84748da6b09b16ad.png)

| Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Name | Name of the salary structure. |
| Code | Generated by the system or entered manually. |
| Driver | Leave empty to apply to all drivers; select a driver to apply to that driver only. |
| Structure Type | Choose **Dispatch Salary** or **Monthly Salary**. |
| Effective date | Date the structure starts applying. |
| Description | Additional notes, if any. |

### Step 3

On the relevant component tab, click **Add a line**.

![](/uploads/db35fb840809fd8d281afd59.png)

### Step 4

Declare the salary component on the trip salary creation screen.

![](/uploads/9f9b5f37493f270a8f4e17ea.png)

| Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Item | Select the item, for example Transport distance, Trip salary or Vehicle standby. Items are declared under [Salary items](/d/salary-items#salary-items-overview). |
| Code | Code of the item. |
| Type | Choose **Parameter** or **Formula**. |
| Effective date | Period during which the component applies. |
| Value based on | System data used as the input. |
| Fixed value | Fixed value or amount that applies. |
| Input data | Data used to calculate the component. |
| Formula | Formula for calculating the salary, when the type is Formula. |

### Step 5

Choose one of these ways to save the component line:

- **Save & Close**: create one data line and close the screen.
- **Save & New**: create one data line and keep the screen open to create another.

### Step 6

Click **Save manually** to save the salary structure.

![](/uploads/b8f7766b95490982657e2bd9.png)

A new structure is only in the **Draft** state. Without salary components, the system cannot calculate a salary. When calculating a salary from a structure, the system uses the [salary standard](/d/salary-standards#salary-standards-overview) that matches the applicable conditions.

sections.title: Approving a salary structure
sections.content:
The structure lifecycle is **Draft** → **Waiting for approval** → **Approved**. A Draft structure is not applied yet, one Waiting for approval is awaiting confirmation, and an Approved one is used to calculate salaries.

### Step 1

In the Draft state, click **Confirm** to move the structure to Waiting for approval.

![](/uploads/9963e8143137e22a7a4f4b01.png)

![](/uploads/10e3f21dce30fd9ec9781b59.png)

### Step 2

In the Waiting for approval state, click **Approve**.

![](/uploads/a3f9ee3d102185043decd70e.png)

### Step 3

Confirm the approval.

![](/uploads/56b2601c0e2c7cddcab8727c.png)

The structure moves to the **Approved** state and can be used to calculate salaries.

![](/uploads/489a2d0164e83a0cae8f93f5.png)

sections.title: Canceling a salary structure
sections.content:
### Step 1

Click **Cancel**.

![](/uploads/d981417fb28a330987863842.png)

### Step 2

Confirm with the **OK** button.

![](/uploads/e5cd287e0d983b3294f84fa5.png)

The structure then moves to the Canceled state.

![](/uploads/f67dafbd987909a254aff1e5.png)

sections.title: Editing and re-approving
sections.content:
A structure cannot be edited while it is **Waiting for approval**, **Approved** or **Canceled**. Any change must be returned to Draft and approved again before it applies.

![](/uploads/a3e915f70d3079a26536391f.png)

### Step 1

Select the structure you want to edit.

![](/uploads/60396964f1d1544b0fb6d352.png)

### Step 2

Click **Reset to draft** to return the structure to the Draft state.

![](/uploads/3a2ad3e65c776276ad15fd8b.png)

### Step 3

Confirm with the **OK** button.

![](/uploads/4f5f8ae8ad4a0aa21b113f33.png)

### Step 4

Change the information you need.

![](/uploads/c97587e9d618181ddeecd38b.png)

### Step 5

Click **Save manually**.

![](/uploads/785ecea39c157f3daea08104.png)

### Step 6

Run the **Confirm** and then **Approve** process again so the structure returns to the **Approved** state.
